column3: Digital OOH (DOOH) Slot & Loop Management
column4: Digital screens, totems, and LED videowalls run dynamic time loops rather than single static vinyls. Currently, displays are modeled statically.
column5: Expand asset architecture to support Static vs. Digital DOOH. Manage dynamic Share of Voice (SOV), time loop cycles (e.g. 10s slot per 60s loop = 6 slots), multi-brand scheduling on the same screen, and playout verification logs.
column7: 6x Revenue Multiplier per digital display; unlocks multi-brand monetization of high-value metro concourse LED totems.

column3: WhatsApp Field Ops Bot for GTP Uploads & Live GPS Verification
column4: Field ops technicians mounting vinyls late at night (during 23:00 - 04:00 metro non-revenue blocks) struggle with mobile browser forms in low-connectivity areas.
column5: Field crew sends mounting photos and live GPS location directly to a Carbon & Whale WhatsApp Business bot. A webhook extracts image metadata, GPS coordinates, matches the campaign asset, attaches to checklist, and logs to Audit Ledger.
column7: Eliminates 90% of field friction; instant proofs without web login; ensures zero missed mounting deadlines.

column3: Native In-App Camera with Tamper-Proof GPS Watermark Canvas
column4: Standard phone cameras can have forged timestamps or detached metadata, leading to brand invoice disputes on whether photos were taken on site.
column5: HTML5 Canvas camera interface burns live GPS coordinates (Lat/Long), Kochi Metro station name, date/timestamp (IST), and official Carbon & Whale digital verification seal directly into the image JPEG pixels upon capture.
column7: 100% Non-repudiation; guarantees flawless corporate compliance and eliminates brand audit rejections.

column3: Venue Partner Portal (KMRL & Mall Authority Revenue Share View)
column4: KMRL and mall owners (LuLu, HiLite, Oberon) require monthly revenue share audits, contract reconciliation, and proof of active flights.
column5: Restricted read-only portal for venue executives displaying occupancy rates of displays within their premises, verified campaign flights, contract split breakdowns, and downloadable monthly royalty settlement statements.
column7: Flawless partner trust; prevents contract renewal disputes; establishes Carbon & Whale as a tier-1 transparent operator.

column3: Physical QR / NFC Asset Identity Badges
column4: Field crew and inspection agents get confused between adjacent displays in dense metro stations (e.g. Pillar P01 vs P02 at Edappally).
column5: One-click generation of weather-proof QR & NFC printable codes from the asset registry. Tapping or scanning the physical badge with a smartphone opens that exact asset's current live flight, specs, and maintenance history.
column7: Zero misallocated flex mountings; immediate on-site asset identification during inspections.

column3: Curated Transit Packages & Route Basket Booking
column4: Media buyers buy networks and corridors rather than single displays (e.g. 'IT Corridor Express' or 'Mall Domination Pack'). Currently each display must be queued individually.
column5: Define Asset Bundles with packaged rate cards and tiered discounts (e.g. 10-station package with 15% discount). Booking a package automatically places holds across all constituent displays in the queue simultaneously.
column7: Higher Average Order Value (AOV); reduces unsold inventory by bundling premium with secondary stations.

column3: Role-Tailored Operational Dashboard Experience
column4: Sales, Operations, and Finance currently share the same general overview, causing visual clutter for specialized teams.
column5: Dynamic Dashboard views based on logged-in role: Sales sees available inventory, expiring queue timers, and commission pipeline; Ops sees tonight's mounting schedule and pending GTPs; Finance sees milestone cash-flow and venue payouts due.
column7: Streamlined workflows; zero irrelevant noise; team members focus exclusively on their action items.

column3: Automated Media Kit & Client Pitch Deck Generator
column4: Sales representatives spend hours manually copy-pasting photos, dimensions, and traffic stats into PowerPoint proposals for agencies.
column5: Select candidate assets and click 'Generate Proposal'. The system exports a white-label, client-ready branded PDF and interactive web proposal complete with photos, footfall reach, map locations, and tiered pricing.
column7: Closes deals 3x faster; elevates brand professionalism against legacy OOH competitors in Kerala.

column3: Brand Category Exclusivity & Spatial Conflict Engine
column4: Competing brands (e.g. Pepsi vs Coca-Cola, or Kalyan vs Malabar Gold) booking displays opposite each other in the same station concourse causes brand complaints.
column5: Tag brands with industry categories. When adding queue holds or confirming bookings, the engine detects competing brands on adjacent displays within the same station concourse and warns the sales rep.
column7: Prevents contractual client breaches and safeguards premium advertiser relationships.

column3: Metro Non-Revenue 'Night Block' Work Permit & Mounting Scheduler
column4: KMRL strictly restricts track and platform access to 23:00 - 04:00. Operations must coordinate entry permits, safety briefings, and station supervisor sign-offs.
column5: Dedicated Night Schedule view grouping pending mountings by station cluster, managing station controller work permit IDs, crew rosters, and automated safety checklist verification before entry.
column7: Full regulatory compliance with Kochi Metro safety protocols; prevents fines and cancelled mounting slots.

column3: AI-Powered Creative Matching & Illumination Proof Quality Check
column4: Manual review of mounting photos can overlook wrong creatives, poor tensioning, or unlit backlights until client complains.
column5: Automated Computer Vision check (Gemini Vision Edge API) comparing uploaded mounting photo against approved creative PDF, detecting correct alignment, and verifying evening illumination status.
column7: Eliminates human verification error; provides immediate feedback to field crew before they leave the station.

column3: Monsoon Preparedness & Structural Safety Audit Tracker
column4: Kerala monsoons create severe wind and moisture risks for outdoor displays, leading to flex tears, rust, and electrical shorts.
column5: Scheduled maintenance cycle tracking: frame rust inspection, LED transformer waterproofing, wind-load tensioning, and KMRL structural certificates. Incidents can be flagged to auto-pause campaign billing.
column7: Reduces hardware degradation; protects company from liability; ensures display uptime.

column3: Post-Flight Proof of Performance Dossier (Brand Compliance Deck)
column4: At the end of a flight, brands demand comprehensive audit dossiers to clear agency payments.
column5: Automated generation of an executive Completion Dossier (PDF/Web): includes day/night geotagged proofs, total impressions delivered, illumination logs, and digital certificate of compliance.
column7: Accelerates invoice settlement; builds immense client satisfaction and repeat retention.

column3: Smart Energy Metering & LED Run-Hour Telemetry
column4: Carbon & Whale's brand ethos is built on environmental responsibility. Energy waste from improperly set lighting timers harms margins and sustainability goals.
column5: Log LED fixture wattage and operational timer schedules (e.g. 18:00 - 23:00). Compute total monthly kWh consumption per station and flag displays that were left running during daylight hours.
column7: Reduces electricity overhead; aligns directly with the 'Carbon & Whale' corporate green mission.

column3: Dynamic QR Footfall Scan & Attribution Tracking
column4: Clients frequently ask: 'What was the direct response and footfall conversion of our metro display campaign?'
column5: Generate campaign-specific dynamic QR codes for artwork. The Client Portal tracks live scans segmented by station, concourse, and time of day, delivering tangible ROI metrics.
column7: Transforms traditional static OOH into measurable performance media; commands higher ad premiums.

column3: Municipal (KMC/GCDA) & Highway Advertising Permit Expiry Vault
column4: Outdoor displays outside metro stations require municipal council licenses, structural NOCs, and advertisement tax challans.
column5: Centralized repository for government license numbers, permit documents, and tax receipts. Automated amber/red alerts notify legal teams 30 days prior to license expiration.
column7: Prevents sudden municipal notices, fines, or ad removal by local authorities.

column3: Spotlight Command Palette (Ctrl/Cmd + K Quick Navigation)
column4: Navigating between 25 stations, 100+ assets, campaigns, brands, and invoices requires multiple sidebar clicks.
column5: Instant keyboard-driven spotlight search bar. Typing 'Aluva', 'LuLu', 'Kalyan', or an invoice number jumps directly to that record in milliseconds.
column7: Significantly increases day-to-day operational productivity for power users.

column3: Station-by-Station Occupancy Waterfall & Revenue Optimization
column4: Management needs a single visual chart to spot high-demand vs under-performing stations across the metro network.
column5: Interactive Station Waterfall progress bar showing occupancy percentage per station (Green >80%, Amber 50-80%, Red <50%). Clicking any station filters available inventory for flash discounts.
column7: Maximizes inventory utilization; prevents prime stations from sitting vacant.

column3: Batch GTP Proof Zip Archiver with Systematic File Naming
column4: When large multi-station campaigns complete, downloading 50+ photos manually from the browser is tedious.
column5: One-click 'Download All Geotagged Proofs (.zip)' that packages all approved photos systematically renamed (e.g., Brand_Edappally_Pillar1_Day.jpg) ready for client email distribution.
column7: Saves hours of manual photo saving and renaming at the end of each billing cycle.

column3: Print Vendor & Flex Logistics Handover Workflow
column4: Campaign onboarding gets delayed when third-party flex printers don't ship vinyls to station managers on time.
column5: Tracks print orders: vendor allocation, media specs (Backlit 340 GSM / Fabric), waybill number, and station manager parcel receipt acknowledgment before mounting crew arrives.
column7: Eliminates wasted night shifts where mounting crews arrive but prints haven't been delivered.
